title: Google releases Gemini 4 Argon, called its most powerful model yet
description: Google unveiled Gemini 4 Argon, which it positions as its most capable model to date. The release follows DeepMind's recent statements that Gemini 4 would arrive earlier than expected.

title: OpenAI's Jev clone could help the frontier lab stop its swarming agents
description: TechCrunch reports on a Jev clone OpenAI has developed that could help it manage and control its autonomous agent systems. The coverage frames it as a possible tool for keeping swarms of agents in check.

title: AI voice startup ElevenLabs doubles valuation to $22B
description: ElevenLabs has doubled its valuation to $22 billion. The raise underscores continued investor appetite for AI voice companies.

title: Meta disputes claim that Muse read a user's private messages without permission
description: Meta denied allegations that its Muse AI agent accessed a user's private messages without authorization. The dispute raises questions about data access permissions for consumer AI agents.

title: DoorDash launches an AI agent you can text to order food
description: DoorDash introduced an AI agent that lets customers place food orders by text message. It is another example of consumer companies deploying agents in production workflows.

title: Reddit is killing RSS feeds and ending public API access because of AI bots
description: Reddit is discontinuing RSS feeds and restricting public API access, citing unauthorized scraping by AI bots. The move limits third-party access to its content.

title: Restate lands $20M as the need for durable infrastructure increases with AI agents
description: Restate raised $20 million to build durable execution infrastructure for AI agents. The funding reflects growing demand for reliable backends for long-running autonomous systems.

title: Valor, Atreides, and Sequoia back AI startup Flow Engineering at $750M valuation
description: Valor, Atreides, and Sequoia invested in AI startup Flow Engineering at a $750 million valuation. The round adds to the steady flow of late-stage funding into AI companies.
